encoder_method_note:
The books on the three shelves spell the message in Morse code: each thin book (width 8) is a dot and each thick book (width 24, three times wider) is a dash. Books belonging to one letter are placed 2px apart and wrapped in their own `<g>`, with a wider 14px gap between letters, and each shelf holds one word ("channel" on the top shelf, "seven" in the middle, "alpha" at the bottom), read left to right and top to bottom. Book heights and colours vary randomly and carry no information, as do the plants, globe, lamp and rug.

ENCODING FAMILY: morse
